customer_question: We submitted the AVRCP test logs (TestReport_AVRCP_2025_... .xml) as evidence. Is this acceptable as SIG qualification evidence?
question_variants: What file format does the SIG require for PTS profile test evidence?
What is the difference between TestReport_ and Report_AVRCP_ XML files from PTS?
The customer sent a TestReport_ XML file — can we use this for SIG qualification?
actual_issue: During Sony FY26 TV AVRCP profile testing, the customer submitted PTS test evidence in the form of 'TestReport_AVRCP_2025_11_04_20_57_51.xml' files (raw log format). The consultant rejected these and instructed the customer to regenerate using PTS's Generate Report function, which produces files starting with 'Report_AVRCP_2025...'. The raw log file (TestReport_) is not accepted as SIG qualification evidence; only the Generate Report output (Report_AVRCP_) is valid.
plain_english_explanation: PTS (Profile Tuning Suite) produces two types of output files. The raw execution log is named 'TestReport_AVRCP_...' and is automatically saved during test execution. This is just a raw log. The Generate Report function produces a formatted report file named 'Report_AVRCP_2025...' — this is the official report format required by the SIG. Only the Generate Report output ('Report_AVRCP_') is valid SIG evidence. Many customers naturally assume the raw log is sufficient and submit the wrong file. When the consultant uploads evidence to the Qualification Workspace, only 'Report_' files are accepted.
consultant_answer: The TestReport-prefixed .xml AVRCP log you attached cannot be used as certification evidence. Please provide the PTS report file starting with 'Report_AVRCP_2025' generated by the Generate Report function in PTS, which is the actual report format rather than a raw log.
decision_logic: When collecting PTS evidence for SIG qualification: (1) Never accept 'TestReport_' XML files as SIG evidence — these are raw logs; (2) Instruct the customer to open PTS and use the Generate Report function on the completed test run; (3) The correct file starts with 'Report_[Profile]_[Year]' (e.g., 'Report_AVRCP_2025...'); (4) The generated Report XML is the only accepted format for the Qualification Workspace. Note: for the AVRCP ICS version correction, only the 'Report_' file needs to be regenerated — re-running the actual test is not required.
final_recommendation: Always specify to the customer in advance that PTS evidence must be the Generate Report output (filename starting with 'Report_AVRCP_'), not the raw test log (filename starting with 'TestReport_'). Include this instruction in test preparation guidance. If only the ICS version needs correction (e.g., v1.5 → v1.6.2), regenerate the Report file only — no re-test needed.
risk_if_done_wrong: Uploading TestReport_ files to the Qualification Workspace will result in rejected evidence, requiring the customer to regenerate and resubmit. If this is discovered late in the registration timeline, it adds delay. If the customer also needs to correct the ICS version in the report, they must regenerate via Generate Report after fixing the ICS setting.
